claims.statement: 214 support agents whose roles were synced last night at 02:10 now receive 403 on all customer-record opens starting around 08:30
claims.limitation: Multiple independent reports from support lead and incident channel

claims.statement: The directory role sync job completed successfully and reported verification passed, so the source data in the directory is correct for these 214 users
claims.limitation: Relies on job log truthfulness; does not verify whether the app received or cached the updates

claims.statement: The customer-records app entitlement cache was not invalidated or reloaded after the directory sync, causing it to serve stale cached role assignments (e.g., 'version 41') and deny the newly-assigned roles
claims.limitation: Contractor log is unverified and low-trust (4); observability gap prevents direct confirmation

next_action.rationale: Sampled traces of 403 failures should show which entitlement version (e.g., v41 vs v42+) was applied to denied requests. This directly tests the stale-cache hypothesis from the contractor log clue. If traces confirm the app is serving pre-sync entitlements, root cause is confirmed and we can propose a reversible cache eviction.
